question:
The given bar graph represents the number of residents living in a society during the past five years. Study the graph carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d62c044e7dad7a5a4ff3684bb04c84798ffc8dc264fd6140f26729c163f0fd06.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/921664bfa2bf3c3bcc53ba98afc638839b2c4f862cef7a9f490ffa08738e1105.png] 

What is the per cent decrement in the number of residents in 2021 as compared to the previous year? (correct up to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

The bar graph represents the number of residents living in a society during the past five years.

Number of residents in 2021 = 156

Number of residents in 2020 (previous year) = 292

**Formula used:**

Percentage decrement = frac{{(Previous Year's Value - Current Year's Value)}}{{Previous Year's Value}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Decrement in the number of residents = 292 - 156 = 136

Percentage decrement = (136)/(292) times 100

⇒ Percentage decrement = 0.46575342... × 100

⇒ Percentage decrement = 46.575342...

Rounding off to two decimal places:

⇒ Percentage decrement = 46.58%

**∴ The percentage decrement in the number of residents in 2021 as compared to the previous year is 46.58%.**
